dd3b8b08b9ef241b039249c3567a4f9376c32d32.summary: A 2015 blog post describes CryptoFortress ransomware. The author began hunting for Gootkit, found a Nuclear Pack instance in France pushing CryptoFortress via CVE-2013-2551 on 2015-03-04, and first took the sample for Teerac.A (aka TorrentLocker). The sample then showed a close identity with CryptoFortress. The author says the post was heavily edited to fix a mistake. Two samples are listed, and the post cites an ESET TorrentLocker report and a CertLexsi CryptoFortress reading.

dd6d41f85b017215453613836f43314d67625dcc.summary: Index page from HarfangLab's 'Inside The Lab' blog listing several threat-report summaries (identifiers TRR240402 to TRR250601). Topics named include XDSpy/XDigo, Gamaredon/Pterodo, Ivanti CSA exploitation, Lumma Stealer via HijackLoader, FIN7 AvNeutralizer, Cyclops, Doppelganger and MuddyWater. Each entry is a truncated excerpt, not a full threat report.
